name: reliantops
description: ReliantOps - SRE Incident Command, Root Cause Analysis & Reliability Post-Mortem Platform

scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const p1 = spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'server', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); const p2 = spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'client', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { p1.kill(); p2.kill(); process.exit(); });"
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server

author: Engineering Team
